name: Workstream E 31B end-to-end pilot: baseline vs protocol fixes, official harness + no-nudge client
status: READY; waiting for 31B capacity (PI: :8300 = A, :8302 = B until their gate sets finish, ~2026-11-05 06:00 UTC)
model: gemma-4-31b-it-qat-w4a16-ct (served name gemma-4-31b); vLLM 0.19.1 server as started by tools/serve_plan.sh (tool parser gemma4, reasoning parser gemma4, NO --reasoning-config -> thinking budget emulated by the proxy)

cfgs.base: engine mode, all fixes off (vLLM-faithful rendering + parsing; thinking budget emulated)
cfgs.full: canonical argument order + history quarantine + intent-preserving decoding (B's closure rule, opener-confirmed) + post-hoc repair

tasks.eligibility: official Phase-2 verification in our Docker sandbox with per-task wheel sets: gold patch resolves AND empty patch does not (runs/gold_routed)
tasks.sampling: stratified toward the public repo mix (fastapi 67 / rich 48 / requests 13 / httpx 1), one shared random order for all conditions

conditions.name: H-base
conditions.client: official swegemma 0.2.11 harness (ADK LlmAgent + AgentTool sub-agent, ToolErrorPlugin, 3 continuation nudges, compaction 14,336)

conditions.name: C-base
conditions.client: no-nudge ReAct client (same system prompt, 9 swegemma tools, sampling, sandbox, verification; episode ends at the first response without a tool call; no LLM compaction, no error-recovery prompts; context bounded by observation masking: when the last request used >24,000 tokens, all but the last 6 tool outputs are replaced by a placeholder and reasoning of all but the last 6 assistant turns is dropped)

conditions.name: C-full
conditions.client: no-nudge ReAct client (same system prompt, 9 swegemma tools, sampling, sandbox, verification; episode ends at the first response without a tool call; no LLM compaction, no error-recovery prompts; context bounded by observation masking: when the last request used >24,000 tokens, all but the last 6 tool outputs are replaced by a placeholder and reasoning of all but the last 6 assistant turns is dropped)

submission: subs/sample_noadapter = data/comp/sample_submission without the two LoRA adapters (adapter weights in the sample are placeholders for the 31B; our server has no LoRA): temperature 0.2, top_p 0.95, max_output_tokens 16384, thinking_budget 4096, include_thoughts true

budgets.note: official inference.py defaults are 100 calls / 60 min / 500 turns; 120 min wall is a non-binding safety cap on a shared H100 (emulated 4xL4 time is reported from tokens)

seeds: no sampling seed (harness default: vLLM random); one attempt per task x condition, paired by task; if time allows a second replicate with the same plan and tag p31b

concurrency.rationale: all four conditions run at the same time on the same task order so server load / time-of-day affect them equally; <= 16 Docker sandboxes; <= 32 backend requests (proxy semaphore)

metrics: resolve rate (Wilson 95% CI) + paired McNemar exact test per contrast
malformed tool calls emitted / delivered, per tool and overall (task-cluster bootstrap 95% CI + Wilson)
first-edit slip rate; edit slip rate by number of malformed calls already in history (contagion buckets)
IPD repairs / rejections / false alarms; post-hoc repairs; quarantine actions
tool calls, LLM calls, wall time, emulated 4xL4 time, prompt/generated tokens (bootstrap CIs; paired differences)
no-nudge client: episode end reasons (submitted / no tool call / budgets)
contrasts: H-base vs C-base (how much the official harness routes around failures)
analysis: analysis/analyze.py --runs runs/p31a_H_base runs/p31a_H_full runs/p31a_C_base runs/p31a_C_full --proxy-logs logs/proxy_p31a --pairs 0:1 2:3 0:2 --out analysis/p31a.json
expected_duration: to be filled from the 12B smoke throughput
operational_rules: never restart the proxy while runs are in flight (a 12B smoke task died with litellm InternalServerError when the proxy was restarted; ADK retries did not cover it)
one proxy per backend; each run writes its own out dir (no two processes append to the same results file)
no prompt_logprobs anywhere (PI rule); IPD scoring uses forced max_tokens=1 generation logprobs
ipd_final: IPD(i+) = VERIFY-THEN-REPAIR (workstream B's reference algorithm; B's strict guard + site finder vendored byte-identical, proxy/vendor_b_gemma_protocol.py): turn generated uninterrupted; strictly valid calls delivered byte-identical (P1); first non-strictly-valid call rolled back to its left-most site (rules closer + opener, whitespace-tolerant, declared keys only), <|"|> inserted (closer cut by B's noisy-channel rule), resumed; <= 4 rounds per call; guarded post-hoc fallback; quarantine never rewrites strictly valid calls

aborted_attempts_not_used: runs/invalid_p12a_restart3 (client lacked context policy; clean restart of all arms)
